def _download_reminder_order(event, email='dummy@example.org', datetime_=None, status=Order.STATUS_PAID, code='FOO'):
    order = Order.objects.create(
        code=code, event=event, email=email, status=status, locale='en',
        datetime=datetime_ or now() - timedelta(days=10),
        expires=now() + timedelta(days=10), total=Decimal('23.00'),
        sales_channel=event.organizer.sales_channels.get(identifier="web"),
    )
    item = Item.objects.create(event=event, name='Ticket', default_price=Decimal('23.00'), admission=True)
    OrderPosition.objects.create(
        order=order, item=item, variation=None, price=Decimal("23.00"),
        attendee_name_parts={'full_name': "Peter"}, positionid=1,
    )
    return order


@pytest.fixture
def download_reminder_event(event):
    # Event starts in 3 days, reminder is configured for 3 days before the event
    event.date_from = now() + timedelta(days=3)
    event.save()
    event.settings.set('ticket_download', True)
    event.settings.set('mail_days_download_reminder', 3)
    djmail.outbox = []
    return event


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_download_reminder_disabled_if_no_days_configured(download_reminder_event):
    download_reminder_event.settings.set('mail_days_download_reminder', None)
    _download_reminder_order(download_reminder_event)
    send_download_reminders(sender=download_reminder_event)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_download_reminder_not_before_reminder_date(download_reminder_event):
    download_reminder_event.settings.set('mail_days_download_reminder', 1)
    o = _download_reminder_order(download_reminder_event)
    send_download_reminders(sender=download_reminder_event)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert not o.download_reminder_sent


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_download_reminder_sent_once_with_tickets(download_reminder_event):
    o = _download_reminder_order(download_reminder_event)
    send_download_reminders(sender=download_reminder_event)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 1
    assert djmail.outbox[0].to == ['dummy@example.org']
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert o.download_reminder_sent
    assert o.all_logentries().filter(action_type='pretix.event.order.email.download_reminder_sent').exists()

    djmail.outbox = []
    send_download_reminders(sender=download_reminder_event)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_download_reminder_skipped_for_unpaid_orders(download_reminder_event):
    o = _download_reminder_order(download_reminder_event, status=Order.STATUS_PENDING)
    send_download_reminders(sender=download_reminder_event)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert not o.download_reminder_sent


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_download_reminder_skipped_if_ticket_download_disabled(download_reminder_event):
    download_reminder_event.settings.set('ticket_download', False)
    _download_reminder_order(download_reminder_event)
    send_download_reminders(sender=download_reminder_event)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_download_reminder_respects_sales_channel_setting(download_reminder_event):
    download_reminder_event.settings.set('mail_sales_channel_download_reminder', ['bogus'])
    o = _download_reminder_order(download_reminder_event)
    send_download_reminders(sender=download_reminder_event)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert not o.download_reminder_sent


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_download_reminder_skipped_for_orders_placed_after_reminder_date(download_reminder_event):
    o = _download_reminder_order(download_reminder_event, datetime_=now() - timedelta(hours=1))
    send_download_reminders(sender=download_reminder_event)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert o.download_reminder_sent


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_download_reminder_skipped_for_past_events(download_reminder_event):
    download_reminder_event.date_from = now() - timedelta(days=1)
    download_reminder_event.save()
    _download_reminder_order(download_reminder_event)
    send_download_reminders(sender=download_reminder_event)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_download_reminder_to_attendees_if_enabled(download_reminder_event):
    download_reminder_event.settings.set('mail_send_download_reminder_attendee', True)
    o = _download_reminder_order(download_reminder_event)
    o.positions.update(attendee_email='attendee@example.org')
    send_download_reminders(sender=download_reminder_event)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 2
    assert {m.to[0] for m in djmail.outbox} == {'dummy@example.org', 'attendee@example.org'}


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_download_reminder_no_attendee_mail_if_disabled(download_reminder_event):
    o = _download_reminder_order(download_reminder_event)
    o.positions.update(attendee_email='attendee@example.org')
    send_download_reminders(sender=download_reminder_event)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 1
    assert djmail.outbox[0].to == ['dummy@example.org']
